questions: Have you started any new prescription or over-the-counter medications in the past 30 days?
Do these involuntary limb movements occur only during rest, or do they also happen when you try to purposefully move your arms/legs?
Are the movements writhing or twisting in nature, or are they more like jerking or shaking?
Do you notice these movements more in one side of your body, or are they equal on both sides?
Have you been exposed to any pesticides, heavy metals, or toxic substances recently or in the past?
Have you experienced any recent fever, headache, or confusion before these movements started?
How old are you?
How long have you had these movements - days, weeks, or years?
Is there any family history of similar movements or neurological disease?
Do you notice any other symptoms like difficulty speaking, swallowing problems, or personality changes?
Have you had any difficulty with balance or walking recently?
When you try to move your arm to a normal position, does it return to this abnormal posture?
Does anything make the movements better or worse - like relaxation, stress, or sleep?
Can you tell me your name?
Do you know what day it is today?
When I tap on your hand that is not moving as much, does the other arm start to move more?
Did these movements and confusion start suddenly, like over minutes to hours, or more gradually over days to weeks?
Have you had any seizures?
Has anyone noticed any unusual behavior or personality changes recently - like paranoia, hallucinations, or becoming more withdrawn?
Are you a woman of childbearing age? If so, have you had any abnormal bleeding or pelvic pain recently?
Has anyone noticed any jerking movements that happen only when you are falling asleep or just waking up?
Have you noticed any rapid weight loss, excessive sweating, or feeling hot/cold intolerant recently?
